differences.what: The section shows when the visit covers SOCIAL NEEDS.
Choose-many, with the codes of the shared list needs: ID Documents is the code id. Expand maps it to social_needs:needs.needs.
Choose-one, labelled as the line writes them: Yes and No (codes yes, no). Yes shows a text box: the V1 referral's details.
The Medication section shows when the visit covers MEDICATION, and needs an ordering credential.
Choose-many. Records the order's category; no order is placed.
Choose-one, labelled as the line writes them: YES and NO (codes yes, no), unlike Referral at line 7. Yes is recorded now; phase 7 creates the delivery task.
Shown only when Delivery is YES.
The Assessment / Encounter Summary text box is the visit's assessment on the summary screen, not a field.

No Follow up section: the lines' text box and date (lines 21 to 25) are not typed, a departure from the lines. A quick encounter is a Medical note, so the visit's follow-up is the Red flags and disposition note's (when, and the date), which is added with it; the phase 7 follow-up task reads that note's. A follow-up here as well would be asked twice and could disagree.
